name: budget-notes
description: Obsidian plugin: plan a budget in a note with one slider per category.

scripts.test-vault: npm run build && mkdir -p "$HOME/budget-test-vault/.obsidian/plugins/budget-notes" && cp manifest.json main.js styles.css "$HOME/budget-test-vault/.obsidian/plugins/budget-notes/" && echo "Copied to the test vault. In Obsidian: turn Budget Notes off and on again to load it."
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
